[IDSP.2.3] Primary effect: invoke
`ds_telemetry_emit_log(engine, &event)` with the
decoded `ds_log_event_t`. NULL log callback is silent
drop per [IARC.1.14] (log is non-essential). A registered
callback that returns an error does not fail the pump: log is
an observational verb, so its failure is not stashed and the
pump returns `DS_OK` ([IDSP.1.3]).
